skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

version.changelog: Add balance recharge guidance to generated SocialDataX Skill.

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only Xiaohongshu comment analysis helper that uses a disclosed SocialDataX API key and npm CLI package to fetch comments for user-provided note IDs or links.

dimensions.detail: It requires SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sends user-provided Xiaohongshu identifiers or URLs to SocialDataX, which is proportionate for the stated API-based data retrieval purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill uses Node/npm and npx to run the socialdatax-skills package, which is disclosed in metadata and examples; this is ordinary integration behavior but depends on the npm package at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to user-provided note IDs, note URLs, comment IDs, pagination tokens, and analysis output; the skill explicitly separates evidence from conclusions and says not to invent feedback.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact states it is read-only and does not read browser data, log in, post, like, comment, or change accounts; no persistence or privilege escalation behavior is present in the inspected skill file.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, Xiaohongshu comment analysis and insight extraction, matches the documented CLI and MCP capabilities for fetching first-level comments and replies.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable providing a SocialDataX API key and using the SocialDataX npm package to fetch comment data. Use bounded page counts or max item limits if API cost or volume matters; only use --all when you really want the full available comment set.
